name: divine-beauty-website
description: Divine Beauty & Nails By Dee - static multi-page website (HTML, CSS, vanilla JS). No build step; deploys as-is to Hostinger shared hosting.

scripts.build: node -e "console.log('No build step: this site is plain HTML/CSS/JS and is deployed exactly as it sits in the repository.')"
scripts.check: node --check site.js && node -e "const fs=require('fs');['index.html','services.html','portfolio.html','404.html','style.css','header.css','site.js','.htaccess','assets/logo.png'].forEach(f=>{if(!fs.existsSync(f))throw new Error('missing required file: '+f)});console.log('All required files present; site.js parses.')"
scripts.zip: rm -f divine-beauty-website.zip && zip -r -q divine-beauty-website.zip .htaccess index.html services.html portfolio.html 404.html style.css header.css site.js assets robots.txt sitemap.xml && echo 'divine-beauty-website.zip ready (site files only - package.json and docs intentionally excluded)'
